reviewDescription: I followed the size directions, but it doesn't fit and needs to go back. I got the 4XL Plus. My current bras that fit me well are a 46 band from a reputable company fitted at a reputable store. The 4XL Plus says it is for 46 band size, D to DDD (or F) cup size. I'm an H. I expected the cups to be tight, but I could not find a better sized bra that suited my purpose. I did not expect the band to be so tight I could hardly breathe. The instructions that came with the bra suggested that if you are having difficulty zipping it, lean forward 45 degrees. For me that made things worse as the girls were even more in the way. Lieing flat on my back helped a little. Ultimately, I ended up zipping it while not wearing it and pulled it over my head like a regular sports bra. The instructions also mentioned something about a hooks feature that might be available on some of their front zip bras, making them easier to zip. I did not notice such an option in this Amazon listing. Both in the listing and the literature that was enclosed with the bra the writer's English was poor. It seems to have been written by a non-native speaker. Of course, that would be fine if there were a native English speaker as an editor. Some of what was trying to be communicated is still a mystery to me. By comparison, the item I was planning to replace is size XXXL. I used to think that one was a bit more snug than I really wanted, and would prefer a different color. Now it seems almost perfect because I am comparing it to this one.
